test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

 A) Occasion

 B) Privilege

 C) Bizzare

 D) Definitely
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **C**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bizzare"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Bizarre"**.
 
• **Meaning of "Bizzare" (Incorrect Spelling):**
 
 
• The incorrect word does not exist in English and is a spelling mistake.
 
 
 
• **Meaning of "Bizarre" (Correct Spelling):**
 
 
• Something very strange or unusual, especially to cause interest or amusement. (अजीब)
 
 
 
• **Example of "Bizarre":** She wore a bizarre outfit that caught everyone's attention.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Occasion** (अवसर): A particular time or instance of an event.

 
 
• **Example:** This is a great occasion to celebrate our success.
 
 
 
• **Privilege** (विशेषाधिकार): A special right or advantage granted to a particular person or group.
 
 
• **Example:** It's a privilege to be part of this prestigious event.
 
 
 
• **Definitely** (निश्चित रूप से): Without doubt or clearly.
 
 
• **Example:** I will definitely join you for dinner tonight.
